title: Telefon va video qo‘ng‘iroqlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz inglizcha professional telefon va video qo‘ng‘iroqlarni ishonch bilan olib borasiz: qo‘ng‘iroqni ochish va yakunlash, o‘zingizni tanishtirish, kim ekanini aytish, qayta ayttirish va imlo ayttirish, ovozli xabar (voicemail) qoldirish, yomon aloqa bilan ishlash, video qo‘ng‘iroq muammolarini hal qilish va muhim ma’lumotlarni read-back bilan tasdiqlash.
homework_uz: Ikki daqiqalik professional qo‘ng‘iroq yozing va yozib oling: ochilish (kim ekanligingiz, maqsad), asosiy qism (kamida ikkita aniqlashtirish savoli va bitta read-back), yakun (keyingi qadam + email tasdiq). Yozib olingizni tinglang: ohang tinchmi, jumlalar oxirigacha aytilganmi, barcha raqamlar va ismlar read-back qilinganmi. Yozilgan skripingizni darsdagi namunalar bilan solishtiring va kamida ikki marta qayta yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: qo‘ng‘iroq 1:30–2:30 daqiqa, barcha tushunarsiz so‘zlar qayta so‘ralgan, yakunda keyingi qadam aniq aytilgan. Keyingi dars: P1-05 Rasmiy elektron xat.

vocab.uz: harflab aytish ('How do you spell that?')

scenes.title: Telefon va video qo‘ng‘iroqlarga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda ofisda yuzma-yuz muloqotni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa eng stressli kanal — telefon va video qo‘ng‘iroq. Yuzma-yuz siz tana tilini ko‘rasiz; qo‘ng‘iroqda faqat ovoz qoladi, shuning uchun iboralar va ohang hamma narsani hal qiladi. Dars oxirida siz istalgan professional qo‘ng‘iroqni ochib, olib borib, muloyim yakunlay olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome! Last lesson covered face-to-face office talk. Today: the most stressful channel — phone and video calls. In person you have body language; on a call only your voice carries everything. By the end you'll open, run and close any professional call.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda ofisda yuzma-yuz muloqotni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa eng stressli kanal — telefon va video qo‘ng‘iroq. Yuzma-yuz tana tili bor; qo‘ng‘iroqda faqat ovoz qoladi, shuning uchun iboralar va ohang hal qiladi. Dars oxirida siz istalgan professional qo‘ng‘iroqni ochib, olib borib, muloyim yakunlay olasiz.

scenes.title: Qo‘ng‘iroqdan oldin: 5 daqiqalik tayyorgarlik

examples.t: Before the call: goal, numbers, notebook, quiet place.
examples.uz: Qo‘ng‘iroqdan oldin: maqsad, raqamlar, daftar, sokin joy.

scenes.say_native: Professional qo‘ng‘iroq tayyorgarlikdan boshlanadi. Birinchidan, maqsadingizni bitta jumlada yozing: 'Nima so‘rayman, nima hal bo‘lishi kerak?'. Ikkinchidan, kerakli fayllar va raqamlarni oldingizga qo‘ying. Uchinchidan, daftar va qalam. To‘rtinchidan, sokin joy — shovqin va fonda gaplashuv professional emas; video bo‘lsa, yorug‘lik va fon ham toza bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: A professional call starts with prep. One: write your goal in one sentence. Two: files and numbers in front of you. Three: notebook and pen. Four: a quiet spot — noise is not professional; for video, light and background count too.
scenes.say_uz: Professional qo‘ng‘iroq tayyorgarlikdan boshlanadi. Birinchi: maqsadingizni bitta jumlada yozing — nima so‘rayman, nima hal bo‘lishi kerak. Ikkinchi: kerakli fayl va raqamlarni qo‘lingizga. Uchinchi: daftar va qalam. To‘rtinchi: sokin joy — shovqin professional emas; video bo‘lsa, yorug‘lik va fon ham toza.

scenes.title: Qo‘ng‘iroqni ochish: o‘zingizni tanishtiring
board: 'Good morning, this is Jasur from Payme'

examples.t: Good morning, this is Jasur from Payme, calling about the invoice.
examples.uz: Xayrli tong, Payme’dan Jasur qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapman, schyot bo‘yicha.

scenes.say_native: Ochilish uch soniyada hal qilinadi. Formulasi: salomlash + 'this is' + ismingiz + 'from' + kompaniya + 'calling about' + maqsad. 'Good morning, this is Jasur from Payme, calling about the invoice.' 'Hello, it's me' — professional emas. Ovozni tinch, aniq va tabassumli chiqaring — tabassum ovozda eshitiladi.
scenes.say: The opening settles in three seconds: greeting + 'this is' + your name + 'from' + company + 'calling about' + purpose. 'Good morning, this is Jasur from Payme, calling about the invoice.' 'Hello, it's me' is not professional. Keep the voice calm and warm — confidence carries.
scenes.say_uz: Ochilish uch soniyada hal qilinadi. Formula: salomlash + 'this is' + ismingiz + 'from' + kompaniya + 'calling about' + maqsad. 'Good morning, this is Jasur from Payme, calling about the invoice.' 'Hello, it's me' — professional emas. Ovoz tinch va tabassumli — tabassum ovozda eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Kim ekaningizni aytish va o‘tish: 'May I speak to...?'
board: 'This is Jasur from...' — nomi bo‘lsa ham

examples.t: Could I speak to Kamola, please? It's Jasur from Payme.
examples.uz: Kamola bilan gaplasha olamanmi? Payme’dan Jasur qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapman.

scenes.say_native: Kerakli odamni so‘rashning to‘g‘ri formulasi: 'Could I speak to Kamola, please?' yoki 'Is Kamola in at the moment?'. Sekretarya yoki resepsion bilan har doim muloyim bo‘ling — ular ko‘pincha qaror ta’sirida bo‘ladi. Kim ekanligingizni nomi bo‘lsa ham takrorlang: odamlar ism-comppaniyani eslab qololmaydi. 'It's urgent' — faqat bo‘lganda.
scenes.say: Asking for the right person: 'Could I speak to Kamola, please?' or 'Is Kamola in at the moment?' With receptionists, always be polite — they influence access. Repeat who you are even if you spoke to them yesterday — people don't memorise names and companies. Use 'it's urgent' only when it truly is.
scenes.say_uz: Kerakli odamni so‘rash: 'Could I speak to Kamola, please?' yoki 'Is Kamola in at the moment?' Resepsion bilan har doim muloyim bo‘ling — ular qarorga ta’sir qiladi. Kim ekanligingizni nomingiz bo‘lsa ham takrorlang. 'It's urgent' — faqat haqiqat bo‘lsa.

scenes.title: Yopish formulalari: muloyim yakunlash
board: 'Is there anything else I can help with?'

examples.t: Thanks for your time — I'll send a follow-up email today.
examples.uz: Vaqtingiz uchun rahmat — bugun follow-up email yuboraman.

scenes.say_native: Yopish uch qatlamdan iborat. Bir: minnatdorchilik — 'Thanks for your time'. Ikki: keyingi qadam — 'I'll send a follow-up' yoki 'I'll call you on Thursday'. Uch: ochiq eshik — 'Is there anything else I can help with?'. 'Bye' — juda quruq; 'Talk to you soon' — tabiiy. Qo‘ng‘iroqni siz boshlagan bo‘lsangiz, siz yakunlang.
scenes.say: Closing has three layers. One: gratitude — 'Thanks for your time'. Two: the next step — 'I'll send a follow-up' or 'I'll call on Thursday'. Three: an open door — 'Is there anything else I can help with?' A bare 'bye' is cold; 'Talk to you soon' is natural. If you opened the call, you close it.
scenes.say_uz: Yopish uch qatlamdan iborat. Bir: rahmat — 'Thanks for your time'. Ikki: keyingi qadam — 'I'll send a follow-up'. Uch: ochiq eshik — 'Is there anything else I can help with?' 'Bye' quruq; 'Talk to you soon' tabiiy. Qo‘ng‘iroqni siz boshlagan bo‘lsa, siz yakunlang.

scenes.title: Ochish va yopish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Endi ochish va yopishni mashq qiling. Avval o‘zingizni tanishtiring: salomlash, this is + ism + from + kompaniya + calling about + maqsad. Keyin yoping: 'Thanks for your time — I'll send a follow-up today.'. Yigirma soniyada ikkita qismni ham ayting, ovoz chiqarib — ochilish ohangi suhbatning ohangini belgilaydi.
scenes.say: Practise opening and closing aloud. First introduce yourself: greeting, this is + name + from + company + calling about + purpose. Then close: 'Thanks for your time — I'll send a follow-up today.' Twenty seconds for both — the opening sets the tone of everything that follows.
scenes.say_uz: Ochish va yopishni mashq qiling. Avval o‘zingizni tanishtiring: salomlash, this is + ism + from + kompaniya + calling about + maqsad. Keyin yoping: 'Thanks for your time — I'll send a follow-up today.' Yigirma soniyada ikkalasini ayting, ovoz chiqarib.

scenes.title: Xabar qoldirish: 'Could I leave a message?'
board: 'Please ask her to call me back'

examples.t: Could I leave a message? Please ask her to call me back.
examples.uz: Xabar qoldira olamanmi? Iltimos, unga qo‘ng‘iroq qilsin deb ayting.

scenes.say_native: Kerakli odam yo‘q bo‘lsa, xabar qoldiring. 'Could I leave a message?' — boshlang. Xabar uch qismdan iborat: ismingiz va kompaniyangiz, qo‘ng‘iroq sababi, qaytish vaqti. Telefon raqamingizni ikki marta ayting — birinchi marta hamma vaqt. Oxirida: 'Please ask her to call me back.' Aniq, qisqa, to‘liq.
scenes.say: If the person is unavailable, leave a message. Start with 'Could I leave a message?' Three parts: your name and company, the reason for the call, when you'll be reachable. Say your phone number twice. Close with 'Please ask her to call me back.' Short, clear, complete.
scenes.say_uz: Kerakli odam yo‘q bo‘lsa, xabar qoldiring. Boshlang: 'Could I leave a message?' Xabar uch qismdan: ismingiz va kompaniyangiz, sabab, qaytish vaqti. Raqamingizni ikki marta ayting. Oxirida: 'Please ask her to call me back.' Qisqa, aniq, to‘liq.

scenes.title: Namuna: resepsion bilan qo‘ng‘iroq
scenes.say_native: Namuna qo‘ng‘iroqda Jasur resepsion bilan gaplashadi. Kamola o‘rinda yo‘q, shuning uchun Jasur muloyim xabar qoldiradi: kimligi, sababi va qaytish vaqti. Raqamini ikki marta aytadi. Resepsion xabarni qaytarib o‘qiydi — read-back. E’tibor bering, butun suhbat yigirma soniyadan oshmaydi.
scenes.say: Reception: Good morning, Uzum Bank, how can I help? Jasur: Good morning, could I speak to Kamola, please? It's Jasur from Payme. Reception: I'm sorry, she's in a meeting until eleven. Jasur: No problem — could I leave a message? Reception: Of course. Jasur: Please ask her to call me about the QBR contract. I'm free after twelve. My number is 90 123 45 67 — again, 90 123 45 67. Reception: So, Jasur from Payme, QBR contract, after twelve. Jasur: Exactly. Thanks!
scenes.say_uz: Resepsion: Xayrli tong, Uzum Bank, qanday yordam bera olaman? Jasur: Xayrli tong, Kamola bilan gaplasha olamanmi? Payme’dan Jasur. Resepsion: Kechirasiz, u soat o‘n birdangacha yig‘ilishda. Jasur: Muammo emas — xabar qoldira olamanmi? Resepsion: Albatta. Jasur: QBR shartnomasi bo‘yicha qo‘ng‘iroq qilsin deb ayting. Men soat o‘n ikkidan keyin bo‘shman. Raqamim 90 123 45 67 — 90 123 45 67. Resepsion: Demak, Payme’dan Jasur, QBR shartnomasi, o‘n ikkidan keyin, 90 123 45 67. Jasur: Aynan. Rahmat!

scenes.title: Xabar qoldirish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz xabar qoldirishni mashq qiling. Tasavvur qiling: kerakli odam yig‘ilishda. 'Could I leave a message?' deb boshlang, ismingiz, kompaniyangiz va qo‘ng‘iroq sababini ayting, raqamingizni ikki marta ovoz chiqarib takrorlang va 'she can reach me after…' bilan yakunlang. Yigirma soniya.
scenes.say: Practise leaving a message aloud. Imagine the person is in a meeting. Start with 'Could I leave a message?', give your name, company and reason, say your number twice, and close with 'she can reach me after…'. Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Xabar qoldirishni mashq qiling. Tasavvur qiling: kerakli odam yig‘ilishda. 'Could I leave a message?' deb boshlang, ismingiz, kompaniyangiz va sababingizni ayting, raqamingizni ikki marta takrorlang, 'she can reach me after…' bilan yakunlang. Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Qayta ayttirish: utanmang, so‘rang

examples.t: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that — could you repeat?

scenes.say_native: Eshitmagan narsani taxmin qilish — eng katta xato. Uch ibora yodlang: 'Sorry, could you repeat that?' — umumiy, muloyim; 'Could you speak a little slower?' — tez gapirganda; 'I didn't quite catch that' — yumshoq. Ongli tinglash va so‘rash kuchli ko‘nikma; tushungan qilish esa katta xatolarga olib keladi.
scenes.say: Guessing what you didn't hear is the biggest mistake. Memorise three: 'Sorry, could you repeat that?' — general and polite; 'Could you speak a little slower?' — for fast talkers; 'I didn't quite catch that' — soft. Asking is a strength; pretending to understand is a trap.
scenes.say_uz: Eshitmagan narsani taxmin qilish — eng katta xato. Uch ibora: 'Sorry, could you repeat that?' — umumiy va muloyim; 'Could you speak a little slower?' — tez gapirganda; 'I didn't quite catch that' — yumshoq. So‘rash kuch; tushunganday qilish esa tuzoq.

scenes.title: Imlo: 'How do you spell that?' va NATO alifbosi

examples.t: Could you spell your surname, please?

scenes.say_native: Ism va elektron manzillarni harflab yozdirish — rasmiy amaliyot. 'Could you spell your surname?' deb so‘rang. Harflab aytganda tasdiqlang: 'Is that S as in Sam?' yoki 'K as in Kilo, right?'. NATO alifbosi — Aviatsiya kabi rasmiy tizim: Alfa, Bravo, Charlie, Delta — mijozlarning nozik ma’lumotlarini xato bo‘lmasdan yozib olish uchun ishlating.
scenes.say: Spelling names and emails is standard practice. Ask 'Could you spell your surname?' and confirm each letter: 'Is that S as in Sam?' or 'K as in Kilo, right?' The NATO alphabet — Alfa, Bravo, Charlie, Delta — is the official system for critical data like card numbers; use it where a typo costs money.
scenes.say_uz: Ism va emaillarni harflab yozdirish — rasmiy amaliyot. So‘rang: 'Could you spell your surname?' Va tasdiqlang: 'Is that S as in Sam?'. NATO alifbosi — Alfa, Bravo, Charlie, Delta — ayniqsa muhim ma’lumotlar uchun; xato qaerda pulga tushadi.

scenes.title: Spelling mashqi: harflab yozdirish
scenes.say_native: Spelling mashqini qiling. O‘z ismingiz va familiyangizni harflab ovoz chiqarib ayting, keyin o‘zingizga 'Is that T as in Tango?' deb tasdiqlovchi savol bering. Keyin bir xayoliy elektron manzilni ham harflab ayting: 'j-a-s-u-r at payme dot com'. Yigirma soniyada harflar toza va aniq chiqishi kerak.
scenes.say: Do the spelling drill aloud. Spell your own first and last name, then confirm with 'Is that T as in Tango?' Next spell a pretend email: 'j-a-s-u-r at payme dot com'. Twenty seconds — every letter must come out clean and clear.
scenes.say_uz: Spelling mashqini qiling. O‘z ismingiz va familiyangizni harflab ayting, keyin 'Is that T as in Tango?' bilan tasdiqlang. Keyin xayoliy emailni ham harflab ayting: 'j-a-s-u-r at payme dot com'. Yigirma soniyada harflar tiniq chiqsin.

scenes.title: Voicemail: to‘rtta element

examples.t: Hi, it's Jasur from Payme — calling about the invoice. Call me back on 90 123 45 67.
examples.uz: Salom, Payme’dan Jasur — schyot bo‘yicha. 90 123 45 67 raqamiga qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.

scenes.say_native: Ovozli xabar tabiiy yozib qoldiriladi — lekin tuzilish to‘rt elementdan iborat. Bir: ismingiz va kompaniyangiz. Ikki: qo‘ng‘iroq sababi — bitta jumla. Uch: telefon raqamingiz — ikki marta, sekin. To‘rt: keyingi qadam — 'Call me back after twelve' yoki 'I'll email the details'. O‘ttiz soniyadan oshmasin; uzun xabarlar tinglanmaydi.
scenes.say: Voicemail is spoken naturally — but its skeleton has four parts. One: your name and company. Two: the reason — one sentence. Three: your number, twice, slowly. Four: the next step — 'call me back after twelve'. Keep it under thirty seconds; long messages go unheard.
scenes.say_uz: Voicemail tabiiy yoziladi, tuzilishi to‘rt elementdan: Bir: ismingiz va kompaniyangiz. Ikki: sabab — bitta jumla. Uch: raqamingiz, ikki marta, sekin. To‘rt: keyingi qadam — 'call me back after twelve' yoki 'I'll email the details'. O‘ttiz soniyadan oshmasin.

scenes.title: Namuna: ovozli xabar
scenes.say_native: Namuna ovozli xabarni tinglang. Jasur to‘rt elementni to‘liq bajarayapti: o‘zini tanishtiradi, sababni aytadi, raqamini ikki marta sekin aytadi va keyingi qadamini belgilaydi. Yigirma besh soniya. Shunday xabar qabul qiluvchini harakatga keltiradi — noaniq 'salom, menga qo‘ng‘iroq qiling' emas.
scenes.say: Hi, this is Jasur from Payme — calling about the QBR contract we discussed on Monday. I just need your sign-off on section three. You can reach me today after two on 90 123 45 67 — again, 90 123 45 67. If it's easier, I'll email the section for review. Talk soon!
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Payme’dan Jasur — dushanba kungi QBR shartnomasi bo‘yicha qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapman. Menga uchinchi bo‘lim bo‘yicha imzoyingiz kerak. Bugun soat ikkiga keyin men bilan gaplashing: 90 123 45 67 — yana bir marta, 90 123 45 67. Agar osonroq bo‘lsa, bo‘limni ko‘rib chiqish uchun emailga yuboraman. Tez orada gaplashamiz!

scenes.title: Voicemail mashqi: 30 soniya
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz ovozli xabar yozib qoldiring. Tasavvur qiling: bir kun oldin kelishuv bo‘yicha tasdiq kerak. To‘rt elementni bajaring — ismingiz va kompaniyangiz, sabab bitta jumlada, raqamingiz ikki marta sekin, keyingi qadamingiz. Ovoz chiqarib ayting va soniya hisoblang — o‘ttiz soniyadan oshmasin.
scenes.say: Record your own voicemail aloud. Imagine you need confirmation on yesterday's agreement. Four elements: name and company, one-line reason, your number twice, the next step. Say it aloud and count the seconds — under thirty.
scenes.say_uz: Ovozli xabar yozib qoldiring. Tasavvur qiling: bir kunlik kelishuvga tasdiq kerak. To‘rt element: ismingiz va kompaniyangiz, sabab bitta jumlada, raqamingiz ikki marta sekin, keyingi qadamingiz. Ovoz chiqarib ayting, soniyangizni hisoblang — o‘ttiz soniyadan oshmasin.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: mijoz bilan telefon qo‘ng‘iroq
board: Listening 1: Client call with mixed info
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash — mijoz bilan to‘liq telefon qo‘ng‘iroq: ochish, muammo, read-back va yakun. Mijoz schyotidagi xato haqida qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi; Jasur ma’lumotlarni qaytarib yozadi, echim va muddatni aytadi. Har bir detalni daftarda qayd eting — savollar keyingi sahifada beriladi.
scenes.say: Client: Hello, Mr Rashidov from Novatech. Jasur: Good morning — Jasur from Payme, how can I help? Client: Invoice 4521 shows the wrong amount — we were charged twice. Jasur: Noted: invoice 4521, double charge, correct? Client: Exactly. Jasur: I'll review it today and correct it within two business days. Your account number is 88 4521 0091? Client: Yes. Jasur: Perfect — I'll email the corrected invoice. Anything else? Client: That's all, thanks. Jasur: Thanks for flagging it — talk soon!
scenes.say_uz: Mijoz: Xayrli tong, Novatech’dan Rashidov janobman. Jasur: Xayrli tong, Rashidov janob — Payme’dan Jasur. Qanday yordam bera olaman? Mijoz: 4521-schyotda xato summa bor — bizdan ikki marta pul yechishgan. Jasur: Yozib olaman: 4521-schyot, ikki marta yechish, to‘g‘rimi? Mijoz: Aynan. Jasur: Bugun ko‘rib chiqaman va ikki ish kunida tuzatish kiritaman. Hisob raqamingiz 88 4521 0091? Mijoz: Ha, 88 4521 0091. Jasur: Ajoyib. To‘g‘ri schyotni emaildan yuboraman. Yana biror narsa? Mijoz: Hammasi shu, rahmat. Jasur: Bildirganingiz uchun rahmat — tez orada gaplashamiz, Rashidov janob.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: mijoz nima uchun qo‘ng‘iroq qildi? Ikki: qaysi schyot va hisob raqamlari aytildi? Uch: Jasur qancha muddatda tuzatish kiritishga va’da berdi? To‘rt: read-back qaysi ma’lumotda bo‘ldi? Javoblarni tartib bilan ichingizda qayd eting — keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: why did the client call? Two: which invoice and which account number were mentioned? Three: what deadline did Jasur promise for the correction? Four: which details did he read back? Answers in your head — we check next.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: mijoz nima uchun qo‘ng‘iroq qildi? Ikki: qaysi schyot va hisob raqamlari aytildi? Uch: Jasur qancha muddatda tuzatish kiritishga va’da berdi? To‘rt: read-back qaysi ma’lumotda bo‘ldi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
board: 4. Schyot raqami va xato read-back qilindi
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: 4521-schyotdan ikki marta pul yechishgan. Ikki: invoice 4521 va hisob raqami 88 4521 0091. Uch: Jasur ikki ish kunida tuzatish kiritishga va’da berdi. To‘rt: read-back schyot raqami va xatoning tavsifida bo‘ldi — 'double charge, correct?'. Demak, ishonchli suhbat xavotirni darrov kamaytiradi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: invoice 4521 was charged twice. Two: invoice 4521; account 88 4521 0091. Three: Jasur promised a correction within two business days. Four: the read-back covered the invoice number and the double charge — 'double charge, correct?' A careful call defuses worry fast.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: schyotdan ikki marta pul yechilgan. Ikki: invoice 4521; account 88 4521 0091. Uch: ikki ish kuni ichida tuzatish. To‘rt: read-back — schyot raqami va xatoning tavsifi ('double charge, correct?'). Sinchkov suhbat xavotirni tez kamaytiradi.

scenes.title: Yomon aloqa: 'You're breaking up'
board: 'Let me call you back on the other line'

examples.t: You're breaking up — let me call you back on the other line.
examples.uz: Ovozingiz bo‘linyapti — boshqa liniyadan qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

scenes.say_native: Aloqa yomon bo‘lsa, jim o‘tirmang — ayting. 'You're breaking up' — ovoz bo‘linayotganini bildiradi; 'I can barely hear you' — juda past; 'Let me call you back on the other line' — qayta qo‘ng‘iroq taklifi; 'Could you speak up, please?' — ovozni ko‘tarish so‘rovi. Jim qolsangiz, qaror noto‘g‘ri qabul qilinishi mumkin — texture muammoni ochiq ayting.
scenes.say: If the line is bad, never sit in silence — say it. 'You're breaking up' signals choppy audio; 'I can barely hear you' means too faint; 'Let me call you back on the other line' proposes a retry; 'Could you speak up, please?' asks for more volume. Staying silent risks a wrong decision — name the problem openly.
scenes.say_uz: Aloqa yomon bo‘lsa, jim o‘tirmang — ayting. 'You're breaking up' — ovoz bo‘linadi; 'I can barely hear you' — juda past; 'Let me call you back on the other line' — qayta qo‘ng‘iroq taklifi; 'Could you speak up, please?' — ovozni ko‘taring. Jim qolish noto‘g‘ri qarorga olib keladi.

scenes.title: Video qo‘ng‘iroq: professional sozlash
scenes.say_native: Video qo‘ng‘iroq — sizning ofisingizning tashqi ko‘rinishi. Kamerani ko‘z darajasiga qo‘ying; pastdan qaratilgan kamera noqulay va kuchsiz eshitiladi. Yuzingizni yorituvchi yorug‘lik oldingizdan tushsin. Fon toza va baxsiz bo‘lsin. Shovqin va bildirishnomalarni o‘chiring. Kamera ochiq tursin, ovoz chiqarib aytganingizda ko‘z bilan aloqa qiling.
scenes.say: A video call is the face of your office. Camera at eye level — a low angle feels weak and uneasy. Light your face from the front. Keep the background clean and neutral. Silence notifications and background noise. Camera on, look at the lens when you speak — eye contact still matters through a screen.
scenes.say_uz: Video qo‘ng‘iroq — ofisingizning tashqi yuzi. Kamerani ko‘z darajasiga qo‘ying — past burchak kuchsiz ko‘rinadi. Yuzingiz yorug‘ bo‘lsin. Fon toza va sokin. Bildirishnoma va shovqinlarni o‘chiring. Kamera ochiq, gapirganda linzaga qarang — ko‘z muloqoti ekranda ham hal qiladi.

scenes.title: Video muammolari: ovoz va ekran ulashish

examples.t: You're on mute — could you unmute and try again?

scenes.say_native: Video qo‘ng‘iroqlarda texnika buziladi — muammo emas, reaksiyangiz e’tiborni qaratadi. 'Can you see my screen?' — ulashadigan ekranni tekshiradi; 'Your audio is lagging' — ovozi kechikayotganini aytadi; 'You're on mute' — mikrofon o‘chiq; 'Shall we switch to audio-only?' — yechim taklifi. Muammo chiqsa, xotirjam qolib, yechimga yo‘naltiring.
scenes.say: Tech fails on video calls — your reaction is what shows. 'Can you see my screen?' checks the share; 'Your audio is lagging' names the delay; 'You're on mute' flags the mic; 'Shall we switch to audio-only?' proposes the fallback. When it breaks, stay calm and steer to the fix.
scenes.say_uz: Video qo‘ng‘iroqlarda texnika buziladi — muammo emas, reaksiyangiz e’tiborni qaratadi. 'Can you see my screen?' — ekranni tekshiradi; 'Your audio is lagging' — ovoz kechikadi; 'You're on mute' — mikrofon o‘chiq; 'Shall we switch to audio-only?' — yechim taklifi. Xotirjam qoling, yechimga yo‘naltiring.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: video qo‘ng‘iroqda muammolar
board: Listening 2: Video call with tech issues
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash — video qo‘ng‘iroqda uchta muammo ketma-ket: ekran ko‘rinmaydi, mikrofon o‘chiq, aloqa bo‘linadi. Nilufar xotirjam qolib, har muammoni qisqa ibora bilan hal qiladi va oxirida faylni emaildan yuborishga rozi bo‘ladi. Diqqat bilan tinglang — savollar shu yerdan chiqadi.
scenes.say: Supplier: ...here's the updated March price list. Nilufar: Sorry, can you see my screen? It's blank on my side. Supplier: Let me restart the share. Nilufar: Perfect, now I see it. Supplier: Any questions? Nilufar: You're on mute — could you unmute and repeat the discount? Supplier: Ten percent off annually. Nilufar: You're breaking up again. Audio-only — or I'll email the questions; that's more reliable. Supplier: Email works. Nilufar: I'll send it in five minutes. Thanks!
scenes.say_uz: Yetkazib beruvchi: ...va mana mart uchun yangilangan narxlar ro‘yxati. Nilufar: Kechirasiz, ekraningizni ko‘ryapsizmi? Men tomonga bo‘sh ko‘rinyapti. Yetkazib beruvchi: To‘xtatib, ulashishni qayta boshlayman. Nilufar: Ajoyib, endi ko‘ryapman. Yetkazib beruvchi: Zo‘r. Savollar bormi? Nilufar: Mikrofoningiz o‘chiq — yoqib, chegirma haqida qayta ayting. Yetkazib beruvchi: Yillik rejada o‘n foiz. Nilufar: Kechirasiz, yana bo‘linyapti. Audio-onlyga o‘tamiz yoki savollarni emailga yuboraman — shunda ishonchliroq. Yetkazib beruvchi: Email menga yaxshi. Nilufar: Besh daqiqada yuboraman. Rahmat!

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
board: 2 Nilufar qaysi iborani qo‘lladi — mikrofon uchun?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: birinchi muammo nima edi va u qanday hal qilindi? Ikki: mikrofon o‘chiq paytda Nilufar qaysi iboradan foydalandi? Uch: yetkazib beruvchi qanday chegirma haqida gapirdi? To‘rt: uchinchi muammoda Nilufar qanday yakuniy yechimni taklif qildi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what was the first issue and how was it fixed? Two: which phrase did Nilufar use for the muted mic? Three: what discount did the supplier state? Four: what final fallback did Nilufar propose? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: birinchi muammo nima edi va u qanday hal qilindi? Ikki: mikrofon uchun Nilufar qaysi iborani ishlatdi? Uch: yetkazib beruvchi qanday chegirma aytdi? To‘rt: yakuniy muqobil yechim nima bo‘ldi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: ekran bo‘sh ko‘rindi — yetkazib beruvchi ekran ulashishni qayta boshlash bilan hal qiladi. Ikki: Nilufar 'You're on mute' deb so‘radi. Uch: yillik rejada o‘n foiz chegirma va’da qilindi. To‘rt: aloqa bo‘linib qolganda Nilufar audio-only yoki savollarni emaildan yuborishni taklif qildi — yetkazib beruvchi emailni tanladi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: the screen appeared blank — the supplier stopped and restarted the share. Two: Nilufar said 'You're on mute'. Three: ten percent off the annual plan. Four: when audio broke up, Nilufar proposed audio-only or emailing the questions — the supplier chose email, and Nilufar will send it in five minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: ekran bo‘sh ko‘rindi — share qayta boshlandi. Ikki: 'You're on mute' deyildi. Uch: yillik rejada o‘n foiz chegirma. To‘rt: audio buzilganda Nilufar audio-only yoki savollarni emaildan yuborishni taklif qildi — email tanlandi.

scenes.title: Read-back: ism, raqam, vazifani qaytaring

examples.t: So that's two units at 1,200 each — correct?
examples.uz: Demak, ikki dona, har biri 1200 dan — to‘g‘rimi?

scenes.say_native: Muhim ma’lumot read-back qilinmasa, xato deyarli kafolatlanadi. Uch tur: raqamni qaytaring — 'So that's two units at 1,200 — correct?'; ismni harflab qaytaring — 'R-A-S-H-I-D-O-V, right?'; vazifani qaytaring — 'So I'll deliver the report by Thursday noon — correct?'. Xatoni zahoti to‘g‘rilang: 'Actually, it's 1,250, not 1,200.'
scenes.say: If critical info isn't read back, errors are almost guaranteed. Three types: numbers — 'So that's two units at 1,200 — correct?'; names — 'R-A-S-H-I-D-O-V, right?'; tasks — 'So Thursday noon — correct?' Fix mistakes instantly: 'Actually, it's 1,250.'
scenes.say_uz: Muhim ma’lumot read-back qilinmasa, xato kafolatlanadi. Uch tur: raqam — 'So that's two units at 1,200 — correct?'; ism harflab — 'R-A-S-H-I-D-O-V, right?'; vazifa — 'So I'll deliver by Thursday noon — correct?' Xatoni zahoti to‘g‘rilang: 'Actually, it's 1,250, not 1,200.'

scenes.title: Read-back mashqi
scenes.say_native: Read-back mashqini qiling. Xayoliy buyurtma: uch dona mahsulot, har biriga 850 ming so‘m va yetkazib berish manzili. Avval summani, keyin manzilni, keyin jami raqamni qaytaring: 'So that's three units at 850,000 each, total 2,550,000 — correct?'. Yigirma soniyada uchalasini ham ayting.
scenes.say: Practise read-back aloud. Imagine an order: three units at 850,000 each and a delivery address. Repeat the sum, the address, the total: 'So that's three units at 850,000 each, total 2,550,000 — correct?' Twenty seconds, all three elements.
scenes.say_uz: Read-back mashqini qiling. Xayoliy buyurtma: uch dona mahsulot, har biri 850,000 va yetkazib berish manzili. Summani, manzilni, jamini qaytaring: 'So that's three units at 850,000 each, total 2,550,000 — correct?' Yigirma soniyada uchalasini ayting.

scenes.title: 'Please hold' va kutilish rejimi
board: 'Can I call you back in 10 minutes?'

examples.t: Could you please hold? I'll be right with you.

scenes.say_native: 'Please hold' — kutish rejimiga qo‘yishning muloyim shakli. 'I'll be right with you' — tez qaytish va’dasi. Agar uzoq cho‘zilsa, taklif qiling: 'Can I call you back in ten minutes?' — mijozga tanlov bering va vaqtini hurmat qiling. O‘ttiz soniyadan uzoq kutish hech qachon qabul qilinmaydi; agar kutish zarur bo‘lsa, sababini ayting.
scenes.say: 'Please hold' is the polite way to park a caller. 'I'll be right with you' promises a quick return. If it runs long, offer: 'Can I call you back in ten minutes?' — give them the choice and respect their time. Beyond thirty seconds of hold is never acceptable; if you must keep them waiting, say why.
scenes.say_uz: 'Please hold' — kutish rejimining muloyim shakli. 'I'll be right with you' — tez qaytish va’dasi. Uzoq cho‘zilsa: 'Can I call you back in ten minutes?' — tanlov bering, vaqtini hurmat qiling. O‘ttiz soniyadan uzoq kutish qabul qilinmaydi — kerak bo‘lsa sababini ayting.

scenes.title: Konferensiya qo‘ng‘iroqlari: navbat va tartib

examples.t: Sorry to interrupt — this is Jasur, I'd add one point.
examples.uz: Aralashishimga uzr — Jasur, bitta fikr qo‘shamiz.

scenes.say_native: Konferensiya qo‘ng‘iroqlarida tartib muhim. Qo‘shilganda o‘zingizni tanishtiring: 'Hi, it's Jasur from Payme'. Boshqalar gapirayotganda eshiting; so‘z olmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, 'Sorry to interrupt, but…' bilan kiring. Ismingizni aytib gapiring: 'This is Jasur — I'd add…'. Bir vaqtda ikki kishi gapirmasin — mikrofoningizni navbatingizgacha o‘chiq saqlang.
scenes.say: Conference calls need order. On joining, introduce yourself: 'Hi, it's Jasur from Payme.' Listen while others speak; to enter, use 'Sorry to interrupt, but…' and name yourself: 'This is Jasur — I'd add…' One voice at a time — keep your mic muted until your turn.
scenes.say_uz: Konferensiya qo‘ng‘iroqlarida tartib muhim. Qo‘shilganda o‘zingizni tanishtiring: 'Hi, it's Jasur from Payme'. Boshqalar gapirsa, eshiting; so‘z olmoqchi bo‘lsangiz: 'Sorry to interrupt, but…'. Ismingizni aytib gapiring. Bir vaqtda bir kishi gapirsin — mikrofon navbatingizgacha o‘chiq.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha ongidan o‘tgan 5 xato
scenes.say_native: Besh xatoni tuzlang. Bir: 'Allo' emas — 'Hello, this is…' deying. Ikki: 'Who are you?' qo‘pol — 'May I ask who’s calling, please?' deying. Uch: 'Do you understand?' — shubhali eshitiladi; 'Does that make sense?' deying. To‘rt: uzun gaplar o‘rniga qisqa, nafas olishli gaplar. Besh: 'Thank you' siz qo‘ng‘iroqni uzmang — minnatdorchilik har doim oldin.
scenes.say: Fix five mistakes. One: not 'Allo' — 'Hello, this is…'. Two: 'Who are you?' is blunt — 'May I ask who’s calling, please?'. Three: 'Do you understand?' sounds accusatory — ask 'Does that make sense?'. Four: short breathable sentences over long ones. Five: never end without a thank-you — gratitude comes first.
scenes.say_uz: Besh xatoni tuzlang. Bir: 'Allo' emas — 'Hello, this is…'. Ikki: 'Who are you?' qo‘pol — 'May I ask who’s calling, please?'. Uch: 'Do you understand?' shubhali eshitiladi — 'Does that make sense?' deying. To‘rt: uzun gaplar o‘rniga qisqa gaplar. Besh: 'Thank you' siz qo‘ng‘iroqni uzmang.

scenes.title: Xatolarni tuzating
scenes.say_native: Uchta qatorni tuzlang. 'Allo, who are you?' → 'Hello, may I ask who’s calling?'. 'Do you understand me?' → 'Does that make sense?'. 'Give me the number' → 'Could I get your number, please?'. Har birini ovoz chiqarib, tinch ohangda ayting — muloyimlik ohangning yarmi. Ohang tinch bo‘lsa, so‘zlar ham tinch va ishonchli eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Fix three lines. 'Allo, who are you?' → 'Hello, may I ask who’s calling?' 'Do you understand me?' → 'Does that make sense?' 'Give me the number' → 'Could I get your number, please?' Say each aloud, calm tone — half of politeness is in the voice.
scenes.say_uz: Uch qatorni tuzlang: 'Allo, who are you?' → 'Hello, may I ask who’s calling?'; 'Do you understand me?' → 'Does that make sense?'; 'Give me the number' → 'Could I get your number, please?' Har birini ovoz chiqarib, tinch ohangda ayting.

scenes.title: Xalqaro qo‘ng‘iroqlar: vaqt zonalari

examples.t: What time works best on your end — GMT or your local?
examples.uz: Sizning tomonda qaysi vaqt qulay — GMT yoki mahalliy vaqt?

scenes.say_native: Xalqaro qo‘ng‘iroqlar vaqt zonasidan boshlanadi. 'What time works best on your end?' deb so‘rang — ularga tanlov bering. Toshkent UTC+5; London UTC+0, Berlin +1, Nyu-York −5. 'Is Thursday 3 pm your time okay?' — ikkala tomonning vaqtini aniq ayting. Va sana bilan vaqtni emailga tasdiqlang: 'Confirming Thursday 15:00 GMT+5'.
scenes.say: International calls start with time zones. Ask 'What time works best on your end?' — give them the choice. Tashkent is UTC+5; London UTC+0, Berlin +1, New York −5. Say both: 'Is Thursday 3 pm your time okay?' Confirm date and time in an email afterwards — 'Confirming Thursday 15:00 GMT+5'.
scenes.say_uz: Xalqaro qo‘ng‘iroqlar vaqt zonasidan boshlanadi. So‘rang: 'What time works best on your end?' Toshkent UTC+5; London UTC+0, Berlin +1. Ikkala tomon vaqtini ayting: 'Is Thursday 3 pm your time okay?' Keyin emailda tasdiqlang: 'Confirming Thursday 15:00 GMT+5'.

scenes.title: Professional ohang: tinch, aniq, silliq
scenes.say_native: Qo‘ng‘iroqda yagona vositangiz — ovozingiz. Tinch va aniq gapiring; jumlalarni oxirigacha ayting, o‘rtasidan kemang. Tezlashmang — shoshilish asabiylikni bildiradi. Tabassum bilan gapiring — ovozda eshitiladi. Muhim joylarda pauza qiling: 'The total is… [pauza] …one million two hundred thousand.' Pauza ishonch beradi.
scenes.say: On a call, your voice is the only tool. Speak calmly and clearly; finish sentences instead of clipping them. Don't rush — speed signals nerves. Smile while you speak — it carries in the voice. Pause at key points: 'The total is… [pause] …one million two hundred thousand.' A pause projects confidence.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘ng‘iroqda yagona vosita — ovoz. Tinch va aniq gapiring; jumlalarni oxirigacha ayting. Tezlashmang — shoshilish asabiylikni bildiradi. Tabassum qiling — ovozda eshitiladi. Muhim joylarda pauza qiling: 'The total is… [pauza] …one million two hundred thousand.' Pauza ishonch beradi.

scenes.title: Rol o‘yini: 30 soniyalik qo‘ng‘iroq
scenes.say_native: To‘liq qo‘ng‘iroq mashqini bajaring. Ovoz chiqarib: ochilish — 'Good morning, this is… from…, calling about…'; sabab — bitta jumla; read-back — bir raqamni qaytaring; yakun — 'Thanks for your time — I'll send a follow-up'. Ovozingiz tinch, jumlalar oxirigacha aytilgan bo‘lsin. O‘ttiz besh soniya.
scenes.say: Role-play the full call aloud: opening — 'Good morning, this is… from…, calling about…'; one-line reason; one read-back of a number; close — 'Thanks for your time — I'll send a follow-up'. Calm voice, sentences finished. Thirty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: To‘liq qo‘ng‘iroqni ovoz chiqarib rol o‘ynang: ochilish — 'Good morning, this is… from…, calling about…'; bitta jumlalik sabab; bitta read-back; yakun — 'Thanks for your time — I'll send a follow-up'. Tinch ovoz, tugallangan jumlalar. O‘ttiz besh soniya.

scenes.title: Muloyim yakun: keyingi qadam + email tasdiq

examples.t: I'll email you a summary today — talk on Thursday at three?
examples.uz: Bugun xulosa emailini yuboraman — payshanba soat uchtada gaplashamiz?

scenes.say_native: Qo‘ng‘iroqning sifati yakunda baholanadi. Keyingi qadamni aniq ayting: 'I'll email you a summary today' yoki 'Talk on Thursday at three?'. Ochiq eshik qoldiring: 'Anything else before we wrap up?'. Va albatta emailda tasdiqlang: sana, vaqt, raqamlar — yozma qayd har doim og‘zaki kelishuvdan kuchli.
scenes.say: Against the ending, a call is judged. Name the next step clearly: 'I'll email you a summary today' or 'Talk on Thursday at three?' Leave an open door: 'Anything else before we wrap up?' Then confirm by email — date, time, numbers. Written records beat verbal agreements every time.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘ng‘iroq sifati yakunda baholanadi. Keyingi qadamni aniq ayting: 'I'll email you a summary today' yoki 'Talk on Thursday at three?'. Ochiq eshik: 'Anything else before we wrap up?' So‘ngra emailda tasdiqlang — sana, vaqt, raqamlar. Yozma qayd har doim og‘zaki kelishuvdan kuchli.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Ochish: 'Good morning, this is… from… calling about…'. Eshitmaganingizni qayta so‘rang; ism-raqamlarni harflab tasdiqlang. Voicemail to‘rt element, o‘ttiz soniya. Aloqa yomon bo‘lsa — ochiq ayting. Muhim raqamlarni read-back qiling. Yakun: rahmat + keyingi qadam + email tasdiq.
scenes.say: Sum up. Open with 'Good morning, this is… from… calling about…'. Ask again what you didn't hear; spell names and numbers. Voicemail = four elements, under thirty seconds. If the line breaks, say it and propose a fix. Read back critical numbers and dates. Close with thanks, the next step, and an email confirmation.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilamiz. Ochish: 'Good morning, this is… from… calling about…'. Eshitmaganingizni qayta so‘rang; ism-raqamlarni harflab tasdiqlang. Voicemail to‘rt element, o‘ttiz soniya. Aloqa yomon bo‘lsa — ochiq ayting. Muhim raqamlarni read-back qiling. Yakun: rahmat + keyingi qadam + email tasdiq.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: 2 daqiqalik qo‘ng‘iroq yozing va yozib oling
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: ikki daqiqalik professional qo‘ng‘iroq yozing va yozib oling. Ochilish, sabab, kamida ikkita aniqlashtirish savoli, bitta read-back va muloyim yakun bo‘lsin. Yozib olingizni tinglang — ohang tinchmi, jumlalar tugallanganmi, raqamlar qaytarildimi. Keyingi darsda rasmiy elektron xatlarni o‘rganamiz — mavzu satrlaridan imzogacha. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say: Homework: script and record a two-minute professional call — opening, reason, at least two clarifying questions, one read-back, polite close. Listen back: calm tone, finished sentences, numbers repeated. Next lesson: formal e-mails, from subject lines to signature. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: ikki daqiqalik professional qo‘ng‘iroq yozing va yozib oling — ochilish, sabab, kamida ikkita aniqlashtirish savoli, bitta read-back, muloyim yakun. Yozib oling tinglang. Keyingi dars: rasmiy elektron xatlar — mavzu satrlaridan imzogacha. Omad tilayman!

quiz.q: How should you open a professional call?
options: 'Good morning, this is Jasur from Payme, calling about the invoice.'
Say nothing until they speak first
quiz.why_uz: Ochilish uch qatlamdan iborat: salomlash + ism va kompaniya + qo‘ng‘iroq sababi — qabul qiluvchi darhol kim va nima uchun ekanligini biladi.

quiz.q: What should you do if you didn't hear something important?
quiz.why_uz: 'Sorry, could you repeat that?' — so‘rash har doim taxmin qilishdan yaxshi; noto‘g‘ri tushunilgan ma’lumot katta xatolarga olib keladi.

quiz.q: What does 'read-back' mean in a call?
options: Repeating key numbers/names to confirm accuracy
Reading your email on the phone
quiz.why_uz: Read-back — muhim ma’lumotni (raqam, ism, sana) qaytarib aytish; xatolarni zahoti to‘xtatadi va ishonch beradi.

quiz.q: How long should a voicemail be?
quiz.why_uz: O‘ttiz soniya, to‘rt element (kim, sabab, raqam, keyingi qadam) — uzun xabarlar tinglanmaydi va amaliyotda yo‘q.

options: The audio is cutting in and out
quiz.why_uz: 'You're breaking up' — aloqa bo‘linayotganini bildiradi; ochiq aytib, qayta qo‘ng‘iroq yoki email variantini taklif qilish kerak.

quiz.q: Which is the correct order of a voicemail?
options: Name and company, reason, number (twice), next step
quiz.why_uz: To‘g‘ri tartib: kim ekanligingiz, nima uchun qo‘ng‘iroq qilganingiz, raqamingiz (ikki marta), keyingi qadamingiz.

quiz.q: What is the correct response if a colleague's mic is off?
options: Wait silently for them to notice
quiz.why_uz: To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri, muloyim ayting: 'You're on mute — could you unmute?' — vaqtni tejaydi va noqulay jimlikni yo‘qotadi.

quiz.q: Why confirm a call's outcome by email afterwards?
options: A written record is stronger than verbal agreements
To show off your writing skills
quiz.why_uz: Email tasdiq — sana, vaqt, raqamlar yozma qaydga tushadi; og‘zaki kelishuvlardan farqli, u alohida dalil bo‘ladi.

quiz.q: What is the politest way to ask someone to wait on a call?
options: 'Could you please hold? I'll be right with you.'
Just mute and leave them waiting
quiz.why_uz: 'Could you please hold? I'll be right with you.' — muloyim, qisqa va hurmatli; 30 soniyadan uzoq kutish esa hech qachon to‘g‘ri emas.

quiz.q: What time zone is Tashkent in?
quiz.why_uz: Toshkent UTC+5 (GMT+5); xalqaro qo‘ng‘iroqlarda ikkala tomonning mahalliy vaqtini aniq aytish va emailda tasdiqlash kerak.
